_notes: prefetch hits: deterministic, measured on the 20 canary tasks with prefetch v2 (v1 had 8). Resolved floor: the canary resolved 60-65% (12-13/20) in 3-run measurements; one run of 20 tasks varies by about +-2-3 tasks, so the floor is set at 8/20 to catch real breakage without blocking on noise.
